[From the mat, the scenarios, and the debriefs]{.eyebrow}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
imgs <- list.files("images/gallery",
                   pattern = "\\.(jpe?g|png|webp|JPE?G|PNG|WEBP)$",
                   full.names = TRUE)

if (length(imgs) == 0) {
  cat("Photos from the workshop will be posted here. Check back after December,",
      "or send us your shots from past years at",
      "[sd33@txstate.edu](mailto:sd33@txstate.edu).")
} else {
  cat("Click any photo to view it full size.\n\n")
  cat("::: {.photo-grid}\n")
  for (p in imgs) {
    cat(sprintf("![](%s){group=\"workshop\"}\n\n", p))
  }
  cat(":::\n")
}
```

::: {.note-panel}
**For the workshop team:** drop image files into `images/gallery/` in the site repository and commit. The grid above rebuilds itself automatically, no editing required.
:::
